LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 8.3.1 WORD CLASSES: SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we show where a person or thing is?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly
2. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly
3. appreciate the role of prepositions of position, place and time in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 8.3.1 WORD CLASSES: SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of prepositions of position, place and time in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we show where a person or thing is?
2. How do you show the position of a thing or the time something happens?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly
2. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly
3. appreciate the role of prepositions of position, place and time in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
